subject: PoC: deployment-mode qualification & next steps (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@lumamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: PoC recap + ask: deployment-path qualification and immediate next steps

Hi Elena — great conversation today, thanks for carving out time. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps for the PoC. I summarized the options we discussed (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and proposed a pragmatic two-track approach so you can make progress quickly while we operationalize the more controlled deployment.

Call highlights (short):
- Primary driver: production privacy + audit requirements for patient data (HIPAA-like controls) and corporate policy favoring customer-managed networking.
- Immediate need: a short evaluation for functional fit and latency/cost signals before committing to a longer Private deployment.
- Decision window: LumaMed wants to pick a target deployment by early May if the PoC shows acceptable economics and compliance gating.

Suggested PoC approach (two-track):
1) Hosted API quick trial (2 weeks): fast onboarding, baseline performance and prompt quality, minimal infra work — goal is to validate model outputs, sample latency and token economics.
2) Private VPC pilot (4-6 weeks parallel): provision VPC + KMS integration, run realistic traffic and compliance checks; this is the long‑term target if gating passes.

Success criteria (initial draft) — I attached a spreadsheet with measurable targets:
- Latency: p95 inference latency < 200 ms for 512-token prompts
- Throughput: sustained 50 QPS with cold-starts under target SLOs
- Cost: baseline token cost not to exceed $0.015 per 1k tokens (TBD after run)
- Quality: pass rate on your eval prompts >= 94% (functionality & hallucination tolerance)
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence & VPC/KMS integration completed for pilot

Questions / asks from our side to move forward:
- Please confirm priority: do you want to run the Hosted quick-trial first while we start provisioning the VPC, or do you prefer to fast-track the Private pilot and skip Hosted?
- Share a list of internal stakeholders we should include for the VPC kickoff (networking, security, procurement).
- Expected load profile: rough tokens/day (or requests/day) so we can size Dedicated/reserved options if needed.

Next steps (proposed):
- If you approve the two-track plan, we’ll send a short SOW+kickoff deck and calendar invites for a Hosted onboarding session next week.
- Ben (cc’d) will scope capacity/pricing options for Dedicated vs Reserved VPC infra in parallel.

Attachments: poc-success-metrics.xlsx, redwood-deployment-comparison.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold action items until I hear preference on track.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0198
From: Elena Morales <elena@lumamed.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC recap + ask: deployment-path qualification and immediate next steps

Thanks Monica — clear recap and appreciated. Quick answers from my side: we’d like to run the Hosted quick-trial first to validate output and latency (we don’t want to wait weeks to see model fit). At the same time, security wants us to begin the Private VPC onboarding work so there’s no delay if we go that direction.

Stakeholders to include for VPC/security:
- Rajiv Singh (CTO) — rajiv@medai.io (he’ll own architecture decisions)
- Priya Narang (Head of Security & Compliance) — priya.narang@lumamed.com
- Myself (Ops lead) — elena@lumamed.com

Two quick clarifying questions:
1) For the Hosted trial, is data persistency retained in your logs by default? We need to understand retention and whether we can disable logging for the trial.
2) Is there an expedited pathway for SOC2 evidence and KMS integration while the Hosted trial is running? Security prefers to be able to start the questionnaire now.

Cost sensitivity: we’ll need a rough top-line cost estimate for the 2-week Hosted trial and the expected monthly run-rate for a minimal Private pilot so procurement can greenlight the SOW.

I’ve attached our security Q1 export (lumamed-security-q1-2027.pdf) for Ben/Monica to skim.

Best — Elena
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@lumamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC recap + ask: deployment-path qualification and immediate next steps

Elena — perfect, thanks for confirming the two-track approach and for the stakeholder list. Quick responses inline and an updated, concrete PoC plan below.

Retention/logging for Hosted trial:
- By default Hosted keeps minimal telemetry for billing and safety (7–30 days depending on account config). We can enable a privacy mode for the trial that disables request logging and avoids storing prompt/response content. For compliance questions we’ll provide SOC2 artifact access (read-only) and a short attestation for trial mode.

SOC2 & KMS:
- We can start the SOC2 evidence transfer (read-only) immediately; our security team will triage any gaps. KMS/VPC provisioning takes lead time (IP allowlists, peering) — typical prelim work can start in parallel while Hosted is running.

Concrete PoC plan (updated):
Stage A — Hosted Quick Trial (owner: Monica) — 2 weeks
- Goal: validate model fit, latency, prompt quality against your eval set
- Deliverables: onboarding script, 5-day pilot traffic run, short cost estimate after 48 hours of sampling
- Success threshold: listed metrics from spreadsheet attached

Stage B — Private VPC Pilot (owner: LumaMed + Redwood infra team) — 4 weeks (parallel prep)
- Goal: prove production readiness with VPC/KMS + audit trail; run 1-week ramp at target QPS
- Deliverables: VPC peering, KMS integration, SOC2 artifacts review, pilot run report

Dedicated / Reserved option: Ben will scope a dedicated GPU pool if your expected sustained throughput justifies it. Ben — could you draft a very light capacity/price comparison (on-demand hosted vs 4 GPU reserved vs private VPC baseline) so Procurement has numbers?

Calendar: propose Hosted onboarding Tue 27 Apr 2027 10:00 PT — ok for everyone?

Next immediate asks to LumaMed:
- Share a short eval prompt set (10–20 prompts) we can use for the initial quality check (attach as doc or Google Sheet).
- Provide estimated tokens/day or requests/day for sizing.

I attached an updated PoC sheet and the deployment comparison PDF. I’ll also kick off a security handoff to our InfoSec team this morning and share the contact.

— Monica
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@lumamed.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC recap + ask: deployment-path qualification and immediate next steps

Hi Elena / Monica — quick capacity and commercial note to support the PoC. High-level options (very rough, will refine once we have tokens/day):
- Hosted (short trial): minimal setup, billed at usage rates. For a 2-week sample with light traffic (up to 100k tokens/day) expect under $1,500 — main value is speed to insight.
- Dedicated reservation (4x A10G equivalent GPUs): monthly reservation starting at ~$12k/mo — good if you need predictable peak throughput and lower per-token unit cost.
- Private VPC pilot: includes engineering time for peering & KMS (one-time onboarding fee $6k–$12k depending on complexity) + monthly infra (can be either reserved or on-demand depending on your preference).

Procurement asks: please confirm approximate tokens/day and whether you require an SLA-backed monthly uptime (we can include 99.9% SLA for Dedicated plans). Also: point-of-contact for legal so we can fast-track MSA + SOW (DocuSign).

I’ll assemble a short comparison slide and a one-page SOA for procurement by EOD Monday after I get tokens/day.

— Ben
From: Elena Morales <elena@lumamed.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC recap + ask: deployment-path qualification and immediate next steps

Thanks all — this looks good. We’ll proceed with Hosted trial first and start VPC prep in parallel. Confirming stakeholders: Rajiv and Priya will join kickoff. Tokens estimate: ~150k tokens/day during evaluation window (may spike).

We can kick off Tue, 27 Apr 2027 at 10:00 PT — please send calendar invite and the short SOW for Procurement review. I attached our security Q1 export for your InfoSec review (lumamed-security-q1-2027.pdf). Also happy to sign an NDA or a standard MSA if you can send a DocuSign link.

See you Tue — Elena
